defects.finding: Every one of the fourteen rows has requiredBeforeFiling=false and NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE. Ten additional-arrest cells, including all four contGuilty cells, are excluded because only the selected ordinance conviction is asserted. CN-10557 instead requires all arrests, charges and prosecutions, including matters for which relief is not sought. The four main-petition exclusions are also not proved by this route: Form A directs the participant to choose ALL applicable disposition branches, so a conviction does not itself negate dismissal/acquittal/diversion facts on other charges. No no-additional-arrests or all-charges-convicted predicate is recorded. The guide simultaneously requires contArrestDt, contOffense1, contStatute and contOrigNums, and even contDsmissOff2, while suppressing the corresponding disposition details. Route membership is not evidence that these conditional facts are inapplicable.
sourceReferences: CN-10557 p6 Records You Will Need note
CN-10557 p15 instructions7-8; p16 instructions8(d), note and9
CN-10557 pp18 and20 Choose all that apply; p20 addendum header; p22 addendum reminder
legal-design-track-registry.json track nj_ordinance generationRequirements ordMatterDetails and ordAllConvictions
defects.nextAction: Restore truthful conditional participant completion for every relevant charge and additional arrest; exclude a branch only on a documented case predicate supported by the source. Preserve the current unmarked guilty election and whole-row withholding. This is a source-instruction correction, not an eligibility or statute interpretation.
defects.focusedTestLimitation: scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/nj-ordinance-refusals.test.mjs hardcodes the disputed inapplicability/ownership as the expected result. Passing the four tests proves consistency with that expectation, not correctness against CN-10557. Repair these expectations from the source when authoring the bounded fix.

defects.title: Assigned docket and hearing facts are participant copying tasks on later forms

affectedFields.effectiveLabel: Expungement Docket Number — Cover Letter – Notice of Hearing (Form E), page 38, and Cover Letter – Notice Expungement Granted (Form G), page 43
“Expungement Docket Number” — Proof of Notice (Form F), page 40
“Re: Expungement Hearing: ___ (date)” — Cover Letter – Notice of Hearing (Form E), page 38
“at ___ (time)”, the hour of the hearing — Cover Letter – Notice of Hearing (Form E), page 38

defects.finding: The clerk assigns the docket and the court sets the hearing, but the participant copies them onto Forms E/F/G. ExpungeDocketNum has widgets ONLY on pp38/43; it is not the leave-blank court caption on pp18/27/30. Source p36 step5 and p41 step5 expressly require the participant to fill these later docket numbers. Source p39 step3 likewise assigns expungDocketNum on Form F to the participant, and p36 step4 requires copying the hearing date/time. All four fields are classified court_prosecutor_clerk_or_agency_owned. The guide line Leave the docket number and the signature to their owners under After the order is signed reinforces the wrong owner. The repair correctly avoids inventing a docket before filing but uses a false ownership classification and omits the later participant task.
sourceReferences: CN-10557 p15 instruction3 versus p36 instructions4-5 and p41 instruction5
defects.nextAction: Keep the initial court-assigned captions blank; disclose these four fields as participant completion from the filed/signed court documents at the later service stage, with no invented docket or date.
defects.focusedTestLimitation: scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/nj-ordinance-refusals.test.mjs hardcodes the disputed inapplicability/ownership as the expected result. Passing the four tests proves consistency with that expectation, not correctness against CN-10557. Repair these expectations from the source when authoring the bounded fix.

defects.title: Sixteen participant-supplied agency locations and addresses are falsely agency-owned
defects.finding: The named officials are recipients, not the people who fill their own mailing address or county into the participant petition packet. All16 fields are court_prosecutor_clerk_or_agency_owned and absent from the exact required-facts list. CN-10557 explicitly assigns the county/town/institution entries to the participant in Forms B/C, and the participant fills relevant agency addresses in Forms E/G and locations in Form F. Examples expose partial disclosure: ProsAddr2 is participant-required while ProsCntyName and ProsAddrStr are called prosecutor-owned; MuniCrts is participant-required while PoliceLoc on the same recipient list is called agency-owned.
sourceReferences: CN-10557 p25 instructions7-10; p26 continuation of10
CN-10557 p36 instruction2; p39 instruction6; p41 instruction2
defects.nextAction: Separate recipient identity/location/address facts from official signature/order acts and disclose each applicable agency field at its source-defined preparation or service stage.

defects.title: Three later mailing dates are required before filing and marked not after service

affectedFields.effectiveLabel: “(date)” — Cover Letter – Notice of Hearing (Form E), page 37; written when Form E is mailed, which is after the signed Order for Hearing comes back
On (date), I mailed a copy of the Petition for Expungement, Order for Hearing and Proposed Final Order — Proof of Notice (Form F), page 40
“(date)” — Cover Letter – Notice Expungement Granted (Form G), page 42; written when Form G is mailed, which is after the Expungement Order is signed

defects.finding: CoverLtrEDt, mailPetition and CoverLtrGDt each have REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, requiredBeforeFiling=true and completesAfterService=false. All are listed under Supply and verify each applicable item before filing. The E/G labels themselves correctly say after the hearing order comes back/after the expungement order is signed, producing an internal timing conflict. mailPetition certifies a completed mailing from receipts, which cannot occur before the initial filing. The guide introductory reminder about completing service only after it occurs does not make these conflicting machine declarations and list placement correct.
sourceReferences: CN-10557 p36 instruction1 and4; p39 instruction5; p41 instruction1
defects.nextAction: Place the E mailing date, F proof-of-mailing date and G mailing date in explicit later participant tasks; retain the source timing and truthful after-service flags.

defects.title: Three Form C special-route elections are assigned to the court contrary to its instructions

affectedFields.effectiveLabel: Successful graduation from drug court prior to 4/18/2016 pursuant to N.J.S.A. 2C:35-14(m). — Expungement Order (Form C), page 30
Expungement of the marijuana or hashish offenses included in N.J.S.A. 2C:52-5.1. — Expungement Order (Form C), page 30
Clean Slate Expungement pursuant to N.J.S.A. 2C:52-5.3. — Expungement Order (Form C), page 30

defects.finding: These three proposed-order checkboxes are classified court_prosecutor_clerk_or_agency_owned and say the Court completes them. CN-10557 p28 instruction5 explicitly directs the person preparing the form to check each only for its named special relief. Their being left blank on this exact ordinance family is sound; the asserted owner is false. This finding does not require marking any special-route box or expanding the ordinance route.
sourceReferences: CN-10557 p28 instruction5; p30 Check only if applicable
defects.nextAction: Preserve unmarked controls and explain their source-defined special-route conditions instead of claiming they are court-completed.

defects.title: The guide calls guilty a held prefill and unconditionally directs handwriting it

affectedFields.effectiveLabel: the election box beside “d.” — Petition for Expungement (Form A), item (d), delivered page 19

defects.finding: The map correctly says this election is determined by the case, requiredBeforeFiling and not route-determined; the six missing paragraph facts and ordinance citation issue prevent an automated election. Yet the Values this platform holds but did not print section says it holds each value and Write each one in by hand before you file, and includes guilty as the election this row states. The later self-help section correctly explains that the election cannot be made from held facts. The unconditional held-prefill instruction contradicts that refusal. Preserve the valid election refusal; do not turn it into a known answer merely because it appears in heldButNotPrinted.
defects.nextAction: Describe guilty as a conditional participant election requiring verified supporting facts and the stated court clarification; remove it from the unconditional list of held values to copy.

defects.title: Saved actual-writes refusals contradict the field map and their own held-fact reasons
defects.finding: Both delivered reports classify all14 route-inapplicable fields and all68 participant-required fields as classified_unwritable_by_role/category role. The same report also calls most withheld known row members unwritable by role while its heldButNotPrinted entry gives the actual whole-row withholding reason; the county selector is mapping_conflict in refused[] while the held table explains a missing valid dropdown option. Boundary arrest1CaseNum has a real width refusal and is preserved as that exception. At minimum these competing accounts must be reconciled for this exact family. A refusal mechanism name cannot substitute for a truthful field disposition.
